claims.text: The authors aimed to improve extractive summarization by injecting hierarchical structure information into their model, which showed substantial improvements on datasets like PubMed and arXiv.
The performance improvements on CNN/DailyMail were small, possibly due to the lack of section titles, indicating a motivation to explore the model's effectiveness in different contexts.
